items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 7 at 2:15AM EDT until September 8 at 2:00AM EDT by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and seas
3 to 5 ft expected.

* WHERE...Edisto Beach to Savannah out 20 NM.

* WHEN...From 11 AM this morning to 2 AM EDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
